principles: Prefer one bounded, high-value tranche over long silent reasoning/execution.
Do not stop at 3-4 minutes merely to report unless a true gate or failure requires immediate return.
Do not extend beyond about 7 minutes merely to chase optional work; checkpoint first.
Each tranche ends with a durable checkpoint: what changed, evidence/tests, next atomic action, and any real human gate.
If a blocking verification/tool failure occurs, report it as the gate instead of pretending continued execution.
Resume from the durable checkpoint on the next Continue invocation.
limitations: This policy guides BCP/project work; it cannot retroactively rewrite past ChatGPT conversations.
ChatGPT itself does not continue executing after a response unless invoked again; resident BCP components may continue independently where implemented.
